function _G.SmartPlayMusic(p15, p16)

		t1.value40:FireServer("ClearAllTools")
		task.wait(0.15)

		t1.value43(t1.value38, p15)

			return
		end

		t1.value45()
	end)
end

local function stopMusic()
	t1.value26 = false

	end

		if not t1.value40 then
			return
		end

		t1.value40:FireServer("ClearAllTools")
	end)
end

t1.value64 = {}

function t1.value65(p31, p32)
	if not (p32 and p32.Parent) then
		return
	end

	if t1.value64[p31] == "GOOD" then
		p32.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 255, 50)

		return
	end

	if t1.value64[p31] == "BAD" then
		p32.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50)

		return
	end

	p32.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 0)

	if not p31 or tonumber(p31) == nil then
		p32.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50)
		t1.value64[p31] = "BAD"

		return
	end

	task.spawn(function()
		task.wait(math.random(0, 100) / 100)

		local Sound2 = Instance.new("Sound")

		Sound2.SoundId = "rbxassetid://" .. p31
		Sound2.Volume = 0
		Sound2.Parent = game:GetService("CoreGui")
		pcall(function()
			local t10 = { Sound2 }

			game:GetService("ContentProvider"):PreloadAsync(t10)
		end)

		local n4 = 5

		while true do
			local v252 = not Sound2.IsLoaded

			if v252 then
				if Sound2.TimeLength == 0 then
					v252 = n4 > 0
				else
					v252 = false
				end
			end

			if not v252 then
				break
			end

			task.wait(0.5)
			n4 = n4 - 0.5
		end

		local IsLoaded = Sound2.IsLoaded

		if IsLoaded then
			IsLoaded = Sound2.TimeLength == 0
		end

		if IsLoaded then
			task.wait(1)
		end

		local v254 = Sound2.TimeLength > 0.05

		if v254 then
			t1.value64[p31] = "GOOD"
		elseif n4 > 0 then
			t1.value64[p31] = "BAD"
		end

		local Parent = p32

		if Parent then
			Parent = p32.Parent
		end

		if not Parent then
			Sound2:Destroy()

			return
		end

		if v254 then
			p32.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 255, 50)
		else
			p32.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50)
		end

		Sound2:Destroy()
	end)
end

	end)
end)

function _G.RemoveFavoriteUI(p55)
	for i = #t1.value95, 1, -1 do
		local ID = t1.value95[i].ID

		if tostring(ID) == tostring(p55) then
			if t1.value95[i].Frame then
				t1.value95[i].Frame:Destroy()
			end

			table.remove(t1.value95, i)
		end
	end
end

	end

local function v747(descendant)
	local isSound = descendant:IsA("Sound")

	if isSound then
		isSound = descendant.Name == "PlayersChoice"
	end

	if not isSound then
		return
	end

	local function v749()
		local SoundId = t1.value10 and descendant.SoundId

		if SoundId then
			SoundId = descendant.SoundId ~= ""
		end

		if not SoundId then
			return
		end

		if string.find(descendant.SoundId, "0x") then
			t1.value112(nil, true)

			return
		end

		local v751 = string.match(descendant.SoundId, "%d+")

		if not v751 then
			return
		end

		t1.value112(v751, false)
	end

	descendant:GetPropertyChangedSignal("SoundId"):Connect(v749)
	v749()
end
